channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Probe launched into exhumation of former soldier’s grave in Uruzgan
item.description: An investigation has been launched into the exhumation of the grave of a former government military member and the alleged mistreatment of his remains in central Uruzgan province, with officials warning that those involved will be brought to justice.

item.title: Defence ministry unveils new uniform for security forces
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): The Ministry of Defence (MoD) officially announced a new military uniform for its forces, including commandos, border troops and the National Islamic Army.

item.title: More than 100,000 People Employed in Badakhshan’s Gold Mines
item.description: Kabul (Pajhwok): Afghanistan’s Ministry of Mines and Petroleum says that more than 100,000 people have been employed directly and indirectly in gold mining projects in Badakhshan

item.title: Explosion in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: 2 killed, 12 wounded
item.description: Kabul (Pajhwok): At least two people were killed and 12 others injured in an explosion near a police checkpoint in Bannu area of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

item.title: 300 Afghans rescued from harsh weather at Iran’s Taybad border
item.description: Around 300 Afghans stranded in severe snow and rain at the Taybad border in neighbouring Iran have been rescued, a media report said on Tuesday.

item.title: 6 killed, 46 wounded as passenger bus overturns in Brazil
item.description: At least six people have been killed and 46 others injured after a passenger bus overturned on a highway in southeastern Brazil, a media report said on Tuesday.

item.title: Cabinet tasks evaluation of Kabul administrative complex
item.description: The Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (IEA) Cabinet has discussed the construction of Kabul’s provincial administrative complex and addressing problems faced by health personnel.

item.title: First ever electronic work permits system launched in Herat
item.description: The process of issuing electronic work permits for domestic and foreign nationals has been officially launched for the first time in western Herat province.

item.title: Afghanistan, Uzbekistan ink $300m trade agreements
item.description: Afghanistan and Uzbekistan have inked 25 agreements across various sectors, including construction, food, agriculture, furniture, clothing and pharmaceuticals.
